title: The Unlimited Elements For Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to,…
description: The Unlimited Elements For Elementor WordPress plugin contains a directory traversal vulnerability in all versions up to and including 2.0.26. Authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher can exploit this flaw via the getFileContentByUrl function to read arbitrary files on the server. The vulnerability arises because the AJAX endpoint get_addon_output_data is protected by a nonce that is exposed on the Elementor editor page, which contributors can access.
